text_block_list.text:
Today, the Summer Training Camp
finally begins.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It's been a while since I last came here...
choice_data_list: Want to eat something to lift our spirits?
Want to grab a bite to cheer ourselves up?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...No, it's fine for now.
Let's put our bags down and get straight to training."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Creek, and Tama...
My rivals are waiting for me to become stronger."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —Once we're done, let's eat a ton!
And so, our heated summer training camp with Oguri Cap began!
